original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚20名被绑架毕业生获救
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚警方称，本月1日在东南部阿比亚州和阿夸伊博姆州途中被绑架的20名青年已被解救。警方表示在伊莫州Amakohia Ubi地区经过持续搜救后将其救出，获救者正在接受医疗评估。警方未说明是否支付赎金或是否有人被捕。

key_facts.fact: 20名青年在尼日利亚东南部被绑架后获救
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A group of 20 young people who were abducted in South-East Nigeria last week have been rescued, police say.

key_facts.fact: 被绑架者于10月1日在前往国家社区服务项目途中遭绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The graduates were kidnapped on 1 October while they were travelling for a national community service programme in the Abia and Akwa Ibom states in the south of the country.

key_facts.fact: 警方称在伊莫州Amakohia Ubi地区经持续搜救后将其救出
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the group were rescued at Amakohia Ubi in Imo State after a sustained search-and-rescue operation

key_facts.fact: 警方未说明是否支付赎金或是否有人被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: he did not say whether any ransom was paid or if any arrests had been made

key_facts.fact: 一名被绑架者父亲称绑匪索要5000万奈拉赎金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the father of one of the people who were abducted, Omotosho Adewale, told the BBC that the kidnappers had demanded a ransom of 50m naira ($37,680; £28,440), which he could not afford.

uncertainties: 是否支付赎金尚未确认
是否有人被捕尚未确认
事件目前仅一个来源（BBC）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
